newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-DECISION ON RAKVERE CASE EXPECTED IN TWO WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-DECISION ON RAKVERE CASE EXPECTED IN TWO WEEKS.

text.p: The securities commission said on Tuesday it hopes to take its decision on a possible insider trade in Rakvere meat factory's shares in two weeks.
"We hope that during the coming two weeks we will reach our decision," commission head Indrek Jakobson told Reuters.
Rakvere shares gained nearly ten percent on May 14 and 15.
Just before trading closed on May 15, the company informed the stock exchange that it had bought a majority stake in leading Latvian meat producer Rigas Miesnieks.
Police initiated criminal charges for alleged insider trading in the middle of June.
If the securities commission finds evidence of wrong doing, it can seek to have the case taken to court.
